** DICGC**: 97.6% of bank accounts insured (March 2025); deposit insurance fund ₹2.29 lakh crore.
** RBI penalty**: **₹11.5 lakh on Mahindra & Mahindra Financial Services** — Fair Practices Code & Internal Ombudsman non-compliance; Sections 58G(1)(b) r/w 58B(5)(aa), RBI Act 1934.
** RBI Consumer Confidence Surveys**: RCCS (Ipsos, Gurugram) covers 31 states/UTs; UCCS (Hansa Research, Mumbai) covers 19 cities — don't swap the two.
